# Andrew Wheat Architecture Portfolio

Andrew Wheat is a Bachelor of Architecture student at Cornell University, expected to graduate in May 2028. This website contains architecture projects, drawings, models, research, and design work focused on public architecture, materiality, environmental systems, civic space, food, water, care, learning, rest, and assembly.

Primary pages:

* Home: https://andrew-wheat.com/
* Work: https://andrew-wheat.com/work.html
* About: https://andrew-wheat.com/about.html
* Contact: https://andrew-wheat.com/contact.html

Primary project names:

* Wood Street Pool
* Enfield Food Pantry
* Deconstruct Reconfigure
* Borinquen Healing Center
* A Chair is a Toy!
* Design District Canteen
* Curanto Cookhouse
* York Prize
* Woven Pavilion
* Sustainable Education
* Ephemeral Diptyque
* Hunter's Point Cooperative Housing
